V1.lens: main wide 5.96mm f/1.6, 2x sensor crop (52mm equiv in EXIF; iPhone 17 has no telephoto module)
V1.endpoint: phone propped on a box on the desk, aimed straight down; portrait for CAL and S1 V1-1/V1-2, landscape for S1 V1-3 and all of S2

V2.lens: main wide 5.96mm f/1.6, 2x sensor crop (52mm equiv in EXIF)
V2.endpoint: phone leaned against a box, oblique toward the thumb + fingertip side; tilt from vertical estimated from palm landmarks at 37-47 degrees across shots, landscape

endpointReproduction: box positions returned by eye (no head lock, no angle readout); reproduction accuracy is what S9 measures, not a controlled quantity here
handSupport: not recorded (no dedicated forearm support confirmed)
N1: handmade opaque paper/tape tip over the index nail, extends <1mm beyond the fingertip (spec asked >=5mm), attached once for the whole S2 session

sessionLog.notes: hand lifted and re-placed between CAL-01 and CAL-02
V1 x2 (portrait) -> V2 x2 (landscape) -> return to V1 (landscape); hand kept on the mat throughout
handmade tip crafted during the ~39 min gap after S1; V1 -> V2 -> V1, all landscape

deviations: N1 tip extends <1mm beyond the fingertip instead of the >=5mm the protocol asks for; it does cover the nail plate and hide the free edge
phone mount orientation was not held fixed per endpoint: S1 V1-1/V1-2 portrait but S1 V1-3 landscape (operator kept the V2 mounting on the return)
camera endpoints were reproduced by eye only (boxes, no taped angle readout), so endpoint error folds into the S9 rigid part
shutter: 2-second self-timer (screen tap per shot), no remote; the tap can nudge the propped phone between shots
the capture environment could not support the full rig the protocol describes (tripod with locked head, angle readout); operator notes accurate data capture is impractical in this environment
operator annotated and analysed in the same session as capture (single-person study, no independent annotator)
